title: RESIDE ITS local-geometric scene-level source exclusion qualification
rationale: The archived global pHash-correlation census was internally valid but recovered only 6 of the 500 provenance-expected Haze4K-to-ITS relationships. This orthogonal route changes only the source-identity method: a bounded multi-index ORB retrieval stage cheaply recalls local candidates, a wide ORB homography stage ranks them, and the already successful OTS bidirectional RootSIFT-RANSAC rule makes the final decision. The prior six relationships, fixed transformed identities, qualified OTS pairs, and all SOTS-outdoor scenes are frozen controls. Thresholds and shortlist sizes are fixed before results and cannot be changed to force 500. No model, outcome, training, or protected data is accessed.

orthogonal_changes.reason: The archived global whole-image method failed its completeness gate; this route instead uses local binary retrieval plus bidirectional RootSIFT-RANSAC geometry while holding data, expected relationship count, capacity and authorization fixed.

scientific_contract.question: Can a frozen two-stage local-geometric census explain all 500 provenance-expected indoor Haze4K source relationships in official RESIDE ITS, close every accepted ITS near-duplicate family, and leave at least 6,000 eligible clear scenes?

intervention.reference: all 1,000 canonical Haze4K clear-source groups against all 11,000 official ITS clear scenes
intervention.matched_budget: one deterministic census with fixed eight-table 16-bit ORB multi-index retrieval, fixed pHash fallback, fixed ORB homography ranking, at most eight RootSIFT verifications per query, and bounded transitive family closure
fixed_factors: Haze4K 4,000 GT aliases grouped by decoded 64x64 RGB digest into exactly 1,000 source scenes
ITS train and validation searched jointly while preserving their split labels
ORB nfeatures 1200, scaleFactor 1.2, nlevels 8, edgeThreshold 19, patchSize 31 and FAST threshold 10
the response-ranked top 384 ORB descriptors per scene enter the bounded reference index
eight exact 16-bit ORB descriptor subkeys at byte offsets 0, 4, 8, 12, 16, 20, 24 and 28 with per-scene key deduplication
top-96 ORB-vote retrieval union top-32 seven-view pHash fallback
the top 24 ORB-vote and top 24 pHash candidates form a deduplicated at-most-48 candidate geometric prefilter and at most the top eight receive expensive final verification
ORB prefilter uses Lowe ratio 0.80, RANSAC reprojection 5 pixels, confidence 0.995 and 3000 iterations, requiring at least 10 reciprocal matches, 8 inliers and 0.25 inlier ratio
final acceptance requires both the ORB prefilter and the final RootSIFT-RANSAC rule
the six archived accepted Haze4K-ITS pairs are fixed inherited control candidates for their corresponding queries before this run

final RootSIFT constants inherited exactly from the successful OTS geometric route: nfeatures 8000, contrast 0.01, edge 10, sigma 1.6, Lowe ratio 0.75, RANSAC 4 pixels, confidence 0.995, 5000 iterations, at least 20 reciprocal matches, 15 inliers and 0.35 inlier ratio
relationship-first counting before deduplicating ITS IDs; multiple Haze4K relations may resolve to the same accepted ITS family
accepted seed families expanded transitively through the same retrieval and final geometry rule; all accepted family members are excluded
500 is a provenance-derived relationship expectation, not a target used to calibrate any threshold
failure to recover 500 is method-specific and cannot establish absence of overlap or unseen-scene status

primary_estimand.metric: number of canonical Haze4K source groups with at least one ITS candidate accepted by the frozen bidirectional RootSIFT-RANSAC rule
primary_estimand.aggregation: deterministic full-census relationship count before ITS-family deduplication

scientific_contract.competing_explanation: Even local descriptors may fail when the current ITS copy differs through severe crop, synthesis, retouching, composite content, or a source-family transformation outside planar geometry. A FAIL therefore identifies the limit of this frozen two-stage matcher; it does not prove that the remaining relationships or overlap are absent.
disabled_actions: training, inference, dehazing evaluation, or model-output metrics
using any image as outcome evidence
changing descriptors, shortlist sizes, controls, thresholds, relationship count or family rule after observing results
stopping retrieval when the accepted count reaches 500
counting aliases, descriptors, candidates or family members as independent scenes
claiming absence of overlap, unseen status or mapping infeasibility from a matcher FAIL
using a provisional exclusion list unless the terminal is COMPLETED_GATE_PASS
ITS measurement execution before a PASS closeout

precision_contract.rationale: The operation observes the complete 1,000-group source census and all 11,000 ITS clear scenes. Relationship completeness and remaining capacity are exact counts, not sampled estimates.

capability.production_path_statement: The CPU contract executes the exact eight-table multi-index builder and retriever at 11,000 reference scenes and 1,000 queries with 384 synthetic ORB descriptors per scene, plus the exact final RootSIFT-RANSAC positive and negative fixture, without reading scientific data.

precision.source_reference: Worst-case Bernoulli standard deviation 0.5; all 1,000 canonical Haze4K source groups are observed.
